name: 仙侣情缘（知秋站 2001版）
english_description: A 2001 snapshot from the "Zhiqiu" site (www.mudfan.com), part of the Fairy Love Story engine family and a sibling to this project's separately archived "Zhejiang University edition" branch, but with earlier code closer to the original. In-game it calls itself "A Journey to the West: Fairy Love Story." Players set out from an inn in southern Chang'an and cultivate through stages of the Tao, martial arts, and inner power toward a scripture-seeking, havoc-in-heaven-style story arc, with an overall casual pace.
